videos.title: 1 - Fast Pushing
videos.desc: Fast Pushing is by far the most common wave strategy in Season 16, so it is important to understand both the strengths and weakness of the strategy.

videos.desc: Slow Pushing is the strongest wave tactic during the early levels of the lane, which can get you massive leads every game if you know how to utilize it.

videos.title: 6 - Bouncing
videos.desc: Wave Control is all about building advantages through consistent tactics, and Bouncing Waves is the most common wave scenario you will see throughout a lane phase.

videos.title: 1 - Laning & Minions Intro

videos.title: 2 - Role quests

videos.title: 3 - Minion Basics
videos.desc: Understanding minions is the foundation of laning. In this video, we break down how minion waves work, the different minion types, and teach you their true value.

videos.title: 4 - Minion Value

videos.title: 5 - Last Hitting

videos.title: 6 - Minion Aggro

videos.title: 7 - Trading

videos.title: 8 - Level Advantages

videos.title: 9 - Recall Timings

videos.title: 1 - Wave Control
videos.desc: Minions do more than give gold and XP — they can win you lane by themselves. In this course, we break down wave control into simple, actionable steps so you can create pressure, deny farm, and gain advantages without ever fighting.

videos.title: 2 - Neutral Waves
videos.desc: Before you can control waves, you need to understand where they start. In this lesson, we break down neutral waves - what they are, why they matter, and how they set the foundation for every lane advantage.

videos.title: 3 - Pushing
videos.desc: When waves aren’t neutral, they push. This lesson explains how and why waves move, and how pushing leads directly into crashes, recalls, and rebounds

videos.title: 4 - Crashing & Rebounds
videos.desc: Push. Crash. Rebound. This lesson explains what happens when waves hit the tower, how priority is created, and why rebounds are the backbone of wave control

videos.title: 5 - Slow Pushing
videos.desc: Slow pushing is how you create pressure without fighting. Learn how to build stacked waves, force priority, and use crashes to recall, roam, or punish your opponent.

videos.title: 6 - Fast Pushing
videos.desc: Knowing when to fast push matters more than knowing how. We break down when to shove instantly, when to slow push instead, and the advantageous fast pushing opens up.

videos.title: 7 - Freezing
videos.desc: Freezing is the most powerful - and most misunderstood - wave technique. This video shows you how to set up freezes, maintain them, and, most importantly, when freezing actually wins you the lane

videos.title: 1 - What is Macro
videos.desc: Mechanics win fights - macro wins games. In this video, we break down what macro actually means, how it differs from micro, and why understanding map decisions matters far more than anything else.

videos.title: 2 - Minion Anchoring
videos.desc: Minions are the real key to getting ahead. In this lesson, you’ll learn why farming is so important, how minions “anchor” players to lanes, and how this shapes every smart decision on the map.

videos.title: 3 - Pushing Waves
videos.desc: Pushing waves gives you time to move without falling behind. We show you how pushing lets you roam, recall, or help your team — all while keeping your gold and experience high.

videos.title: 4 - Numbers Advantage
videos.desc: Winning fights is obviously easier when you have more players. This lesson teaches how pushing waves creates numbers advantages, and how to use those moments to force winning plays.

videos.title: 5 - Preparing Objectives
videos.desc: Most objective fights are decided before they even start. Learn how to prepare for dragons and other objectives by resetting properly, setting vision early, and fighting on your terms.

videos.title: 1 - Vision Intro
videos.desc: Vision is one of the fastest ways to instantly improve in League. In this course, you’ll learn exactly how vision works, what each ward is for, and the simple habits that keep you safe, stop ganks, and help your team win fights before they even start.

videos.title: 2 - Vision Basics
videos.desc: Fog of War is why League feels chaotic - and why good players always look “one step ahead.” This lesson breaks down how vision actually works, how bushes change what you can see, and how to use that knowledge to avoid getting surprised, caught out, or cheesed in lane.

videos.title: 3 - Stealth Wards
videos.desc: Stealth Wards are your primary tool for staying safe and gathering information in every game. We break down how they work, how long they last, and a few other must-know tips and tricks.

videos.title: 4 - Control Wards
videos.desc: Control Wards are one of the strongest vision tools in League. In this video, we break down how they work, why they’re so valuable, and how a single well-placed Control Ward can completely lock down an area of the map.

videos.title: 5 - Oracle Lens
videos.desc: Oracle Lens is how you prevent getting spotted. Learn when to swap trinkets, how to reveal hidden wards and traps, and how denying vision makes every gank and rotation more deadly.

videos.title: 6 - Stealth Explained
videos.desc: Stealth mechanics in League are confusing. Learn the difference between Camouflage and Invisibility, how champions like Evelynn and Teemo actually work, and exactly what can (and can’t) reveal them.

videos.title: 7 - How to Place Wards
videos.desc: Knowing what each ward does is is only the first step, the most important part is placing them. Int his video we'll show you the tricks pro players use to ensure every ward has insane value.

videos.title: 8 - Faelights
videos.desc: Season 16 introduced Faelights, and they’re basically “premium ward locations” that give insane extra info - especially for newer players. We’ll show you how to use them and even cover some secret tricks.

videos.title: 1 - Settings Intro
videos.desc: New to League of Legends? This course is designed to make your first steps simple and stress-free. Providing you with the most important settings experienced players use EVERY game.

videos.desc: Still clicking the little + to level up your abilities? This simple keybind lets you level skills instantly - without ever taking your mouse off the fight.

videos.desc: If you’re not using Quick Cast, you’re literally casting abilities slower than you need to. In this video, we break down every cast type and show you how to get the speed of Quick Cast with the safety of indicators.

videos.desc: Camera control is one of the most important skills in League — and one the tutorial barely teaches at all. In this video, we teach you everything you need to know to get you started.

videos.title: 6 - WASD Controls
videos.desc: League now supports WASD movement - and for many players, it’s a game-changer. In this video, we break down how WASD works, how to set it up, and who it’s actually best for, so you can decide if it’s the right way for you to play.

videos.title: 7 - Ping System
videos.desc: League’s ping system is your team’s universal language. In this video, we break down the essential pings every beginner needs to know, how to use them correctly, and how simple, well-timed pings can win games without typing a single word.

videos.title: 8 - Attack Move
videos.desc: Attack Move is one of the biggest mechanical upgrades you can make in League. Learn how to auto attack like a pro, kite smoothly, and never throw fights again because of a single misclick.

videos.desc: Welcome to Skill-capped's ULTIMATE macro course. Join us as we break down the solo queue macro that ACTUALLY works in season 16.

videos.title: Step 1: Strong Side & Weak Side
videos.desc:
Macro starts before minions even arrive in lane.
Master this concept, and you’ll stop dying to “random” ganks - and start winning lanes by playing the map correctly from level one.

videos.title: Step 2: The Value of Pushing Waves
videos.desc: Junglers make the first macro decision, but laners make the second. Learn all about the value of pushing waves and the effect it has on the game.

videos.title: Step 3: Rebounding & Freezing
videos.desc: Correct wave control completely changes how the macro game is played. In this video, we break down Rebounds and Freezes - and how they let you win the lane without even fighting.

videos.title: Step 4: Priority: The Basics
videos.desc: Priority lets you move and make macro decisions on the map first - but it’s not always a good thing. In this video, we break down why.

videos.title: Step 5: Priority: The Part Everyone Gets Wrong
videos.desc: Priority tells you who can move - but that doesn’t mean they should. We break down the biggest mistake players make with priority, and how misusing priority can actually lose you games in Season 16.

videos.title: Step 6: The Season 16 Timers You NEED to KNOW
videos.desc: These Season 16 timers decide the entire game. Learn them, and you’ll start predicting plays, controlling objectives, and winning games through macro alone.

videos.title: Step 7: Mid Game Lane Assignments
videos.desc: Mid game macro starts with lane assignments. In this video, we explain who should be where and why getting this wrong could be costing you games.

videos.title: Step 8: The 3 Zones of Side Lane Macro
videos.desc: Every good macro play starts with a minion wave. In this video, we break down the 3 Zones of side lane macro and why pushing waves is the foundation of winning mid and late game.

videos.title: Step 9: The Push & Collapse Strategy
videos.desc: Most players push waves and waste the advantage. Learn how to Push and Collapse properly to turn side lane pressure into kills, towers, and objectives.

videos.title: Step 10: Season 16 Towers Breakdown
videos.desc: Towers work very differently in Season 16. This video breaks down turret plating, overgrowth, and how to know when hitting a tower is worth it - and when it’s a waste of tempo.

videos.title: Step 11: How to Take Over the Map Through Split Pushing
videos.desc: Split pushing is one of the highest-risk, highest-reward strategies in League. Learn how to judge risk vs reward, waste your opponents time, and take over the map without coin-flipping fights.

videos.title: Step 12: Why Matching Your Team's Pressure Leads to Better Results
videos.desc: Most players die in side lanes for one simple reason: they pressure alone. This video breaks down how matching your team’s pressure turns risky plays into free advantages.

videos.title: Step 13: Pushing Mid is an Overpowered Macro Tactic
videos.desc: Mid lane is the center of the map - and whoever controls it controls the game. In this video, we break down why pushing mid is one of the most overpowered macro tactics in League, and how it unlocks pressure everywhere else.

videos.title: Step 14: The Correct Way to Play Around Objectives
videos.desc: If you’re 5v5’ing fairly at objectives, you’re already making a mistake. Learn the correct way to set them up in Season 16 solo queue.

videos.title: Step 15: The Secrets to Using This Course Effectively
videos.desc: You don’t need insane mechanics to climb - you need better decisions. Here’s how to use this course to build winning macro habits that actually stick.
